crossRefs.note: Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.
They soon forgot his works. They didn’t wait for his counsel,
Yahweh heard the voice of your words when you spoke to me; and Yahweh said to me, “I have heard the voice of the words…
Oh that there were such a heart in them that they would fear me and keep all my commandments always, that it might be…
The Lord said, “Because this people draws near with their mouth and honors me with their lips, but they have removed…
They come to you as the people come, and they sit before you as my people, and they hear your words, but don’t do them…
Ephraim surrounds me with falsehood, and the house of Israel with deceit. Judah still strays from God, and is…
As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me. The foreigners shall submit themselves to me.

translations.web: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.
translations.bsb: But they deceived Him with their mouths, and lied to Him with their tongues.
translations.kjv: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.
translations.asv: But they flattered him with their mouth, And lied unto him with their tongue.
